title: Pack the frame-fetch index ngnnguynchn/flag2027-frames-index-p (FLAG_46 selection / timestamps / shard_listing / face_meta; FLAG_53 listing_{dev,test}_mp4.parquet / face_meta)

modes.train: not run by default: collect stages run only when forced (configs/modes.json collect_kind_runs_only_when_forced) and every collected dataset is read from FF_DATA/01_collected (class 'collected' is in always_saved_classes). Re-collecting: force the whole collect closure in ONE run, with a fresh FF_WORK and FF_USE_SAVED=collected (README.md of 11_collect): FF_FORCE=c37_vox2,c53_vox2b,c46_voxblink,c45_frames_vox2,c_frames_index,c63_frames,c87_frames_bridge,c63v_audio_cache. Forcing this stage alone mixes its new rows with the old frames / audio cache (sampling is not deterministic). c_frames_index reads the kernel output of c53_vox2b (listing_{dev,test}_mp4.parquet): it runs in the same run as c53, or from FF_DATA/01_collected/voxceleb2_flag53 once that folder also holds the two listing parquets (c53 skip_with).
